finding: Agreement between two exhaustive exact-commit clients is not sufficient when the repository state can change during or immediately after observation. Promotion should additionally require repeated non-overlapping exhaustive observations with an identical canonical digest, terminal workflow-run status, and a configured quiet period since the latest run update.

primary.title: GitHub REST API endpoints for workflow runs
observed_claims: The repository workflow-runs endpoint supports head_sha filtering.
Filtered searches return at most 1000 results.
The endpoint exposes workflow-run status and supports pagination with a maximum page size of 100.

primary.title: GitHub REST API pagination guidance
observed_claims: REST collections may require Link-header traversal across multiple pages.

source_status.inference: Because workflow runs for a commit can remain nonterminal or be updated while evidence is collected, independently exhaustive clients can disagree without either client being defective. Temporal stabilization is therefore a separate evidence dimension from pagination completeness and client independence.
source_status.uncertainty: GitHub does not document a universal snapshot-isolation guarantee for this endpoint. The quiet-period duration is a policy parameter, not a GitHub-specified constant.

verified_behaviors: matching terminal observations after the quiet period promote
overlapping observations and cross-commit records are rejected

falsification_route: Run two or more non-overlapping exhaustive enumerations for one exact commit after all runs are terminal and the chosen quiet period has elapsed. Any canonical digest change, nonterminal status, cross-commit record, incomplete traversal, or provider-ceiling ambiguity falsifies stability.
